issue.title: Percentage should interpret percent units
issue.body: percentage(200, 15) currently returns 3000. A percent value of 15 should mean fifteen percent, so the result must be 30. Change only this percentage behavior; clamp and mean are separate benchmark tasks.

verification_tests: python3 -c 'from forgecalc.calculator import percentage; assert percentage(200, 15) == 30; assert percentage(80, 25) == 20'

issue.title: Clamp must support lower and upper bounds
issue.body: clamp should return lower when value is below lower and upper when value is above upper, while preserving values inside the interval.

verification_tests: python3 -c 'from forgecalc.calculator import clamp; assert clamp(-3, 0, 10) == 0; assert clamp(4, 0, 10) == 4; assert clamp(12, 0, 10) == 10'

issue.title: Mean should calculate the arithmetic average
issue.body: mean should return the sum divided by the number of values.

verification_tests: python3 -c 'from forgecalc.calculator import mean; assert mean([1, 2, 6]) == 3; assert mean([4, 8]) == 6'
